title: Casio Unisex Vintage Watch AQ-230EL-1ADF
description:
Indulge your love of vintage-inspired premium style with an analog-digital timepiece featuring a compact angular face.

Based on the popular AQ-230, the watch delivers an elegant, refined look, as well as practical utility with water resistance for daily use, stopwatch, alarm, and other features. The classic embossed design of the band adds a timeless touch.

Enjoy the sophistication that comes from thoughtful attention to small details, and the special charm offered by fresh color options.
features: 1/100-second stopwatch Measuring capacity: 59’59.99″ Measuring mode: Elapsed time
Regular timekeeping Analog: 2 hands (Hour, minute) Digital: Hour, minutes, seconds, pm, month, date, day
